units.source_text: 公主吃惊之余，十分伤心，痛恨她的侍女。

en.t: The princess was startled and deeply grieved, and she bitterly hated her attendant.

units.source_text: 她想：“世间人心如此不测，我身将来苦患正多呢！”

en.t: She thought, "People's hearts in this world are so unpredictable; many sufferings must still await me."

units.source_text: 她想起此身已无可信赖之人，便反复悲伤。

en.t: Remembering that there was no one left whom she could trust, she sank again and again into sorrow.

units.source_text: 夕雾说出种种理由，希望公主谅解。

en.t: Yugiri offered all kinds of explanations, hoping the princess would understand.

units.source_text: 话语甚多，有的情趣动人，有的意味丰富。

en.t: He said many things, some moving in their feeling and some rich in implication.

units.source_text: 但公主只觉得可恨可恶。

en.t: But to the princess they seemed only hateful and repellent.

units.source_text: 夕雾说道：“你把我看作毫不足道之人，使我羞耻无似。

en.t: Yugiri said, "You regard me as someone of no worth at all, and you shame me beyond measure.

units.source_text: 我因思虑不足，起了这个荒唐之念，如今不胜后悔，然而无可挽回了。

en.t: Because I lacked judgment, I conceived this absurd desire; now I regret it more than I can bear, yet it cannot be undone.

units.source_text: 但公主又岂能保持清白之名呢？

en.t: But how could Your Highness still preserve a spotless reputation?

units.source_text: 无可奈何，只得屈节了。

en.t: There is nothing to be done; you can only bend your pride and yield.

units.source_text: 人生在世，到了不称意之时，往往有投身深渊者。

en.t: In this life, when things become unbearable, people often cast themselves into a deep abyss.

units.source_text: 就请公主把我的心当作深渊，投身其中吧！”

en.t: So please think of my heart as that abyss, and throw yourself into it."

units.source_text: 公主把一件单衣牢裹在身上，除了号哭之外毫无办法。

en.t: The princess wrapped a single robe tightly around herself and could do nothing but weep aloud.

units.source_text: 那恐惧担心的样子实甚可怜。

en.t: Her frightened, anxious appearance was truly pitiful.

units.source_text: 夕雾想道：“无可奈何了！

en.t: Yugiri thought, "There is no help for it now.

units.source_text: 怎么会如此嫌恶我呢？

en.t: How can she loathe me so much?

units.source_text: 无论何等坚贞的女子，到了这个地步，心情自会松懈起来的。

en.t: No matter how steadfast a woman may be, once matters reach this point, her heart should naturally soften.

units.source_text: 岂知这位公主心肠竟同木石一般，坚决不肯屈从。

en.t: Who would have thought this princess's heart would be like wood or stone, refusing absolutely to submit?

units.source_text: 没有宿世因缘的人，见面只觉可嫌，此人对我大约也是如此吧。”

en.t: When people share no bond from a former life, they find each other hateful on meeting; perhaps that is how she feels toward me."

units.source_text: 想到这里，觉得此事太不近情，心中不胜懊恼。

en.t: Thinking this, he felt the whole affair was far too contrary to human feeling, and his heart was filled with unbearable vexation.

units.source_text: 他想起云居雁此刻心情一定不快，又回想当年两小无猜、互相爱慕之状，以及多年来情投意合、互相信赖之状，便觉此次自讨烦恼，实在无聊之极。

en.t: He thought of how Kumoinokari must surely be unhappy at that moment, and remembered how innocently close and fond of each other they had been as children, and how for many years their feelings had matched and they had trusted one another; then he felt that this time he had brought trouble on himself, and that it was utterly foolish.

units.source_text: 因此也不勉强抚慰公主，只管悲伤叹息，直到天明。

en.t: Because of this, he did not force himself to comfort the princess, but only grieved and sighed until dawn.

units.source_text: 他觉得每次空自来去，太不成样，今天就留在这里，安闲地度送一天。

en.t: He felt it was too unseemly to keep coming and going in vain, so today he stayed there and passed the day at leisure.

units.source_text: 公主见他如此顽强，非常讨厌，越发疏远他了。

en.t: Seeing him so obstinate, the princess found him extremely detestable and drew away from him all the more.

units.source_text: 夕雾则一方面笑她愚痴，一方面恨她无情。

en.t: Yugiri, for his part, laughed at her foolishness on one hand and resented her coldness on the other.
